comments.value: I think this should be a feature that gets implemented in case an accident happens. Although, I think people who are photosensitive or epileptic shouldn't play VR because it's an obvious given. Anybody can play particles at any given moment, even friends potentially on accident even with strict shield levels. I think a content warning would help prevent issues that might make VRChat potentially liable. If implemented, it should be required to put the content warning on a world that may involve photosensitivity/flashing lights and whoever goes against this should be given a warning or ban. Although, it would be hard for older worlds to be updated with this so maybe the community should be involved in some way to decide if it deserves a content warning or not.

I'd go with a broader "Photosensitive" warning than explicitly "Epileptic", just because it's one of those things where some people will read the latter and not think it applies to them and then, whoops, migraine. 

Definitely apply this to Avatar tags as well, so you can just disable anything with that tag from a setting.

details:
I would like to suggest adding a photosensitivity or epilepsy warning option to VRChat’s existing content tag system.

I’m one of the owners of Latin Gang, one of the largest VRChat animation communities, and many of our creators produce visually intensive content using flashing lights, strobes, rapid color changes, particles, and other effects that may affect photosensitive users.

VRChat already has content tags intended to help users control what kinds of content they are exposed to, so I think photosensitivity would be a valuable addition to that system.

Creators could voluntarily mark avatars or other applicable content as containing intense flashing or potentially photosensitive effects. Users could then choose to hide, restrict, or otherwise be warned about that content through their existing safety settings.

This would give creators a standardized way to responsibly label visually intense content while giving photosensitive users greater control over what they encounter in VRChat.
title: Add a Photosensitivity / Epilepsy Content Tag
